fusions.name: Closed Fist
fusions.desc: Closes a fist of gripping air on the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Release
fusions.desc: Releases a blade of wind at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Reeled Close
fusions.desc: A beckoning gust pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unslipping Grasp
fusions.desc: Conjures a glove of moving air: you attack 6% faster, your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 3 health.
